name: Tivoli (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of maroon (purple-red) and navy blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tivoli (a white bridge and towers on red and blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Tivoli, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Prime Minister on 25 June 1945.

features.role: Tivoli arms — white bridge and towers on red and blue, crowned, within branches
